diagnostics.message: :module.forge_trust_validator_lambda: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_cloudwatch_log_group.forge_trust_validator_lambda is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_cloudwatch_event_target.forge_trust_validator_lambda: explicit depends_on of :module.forge_trust_validator_lambda is redundant — already implied by attribute references
The module already has an implicit dependency on the log group through its logging_log_group argument, so this explicit depends_on duplicates that ordering.
The EventBridge target already implicitly depends on the Lambda module through its arn argument, so the explicit depends_on duplicates that dependency.

The null_resource updates a Forge role trust policy to name the Lambda execution role as a principal, but it does not wait for the Lambda module to create that role. Ensure the role exists before applying the trust-policy update.
The EventBridge target can become active before the Lambda permission is installed, allowing scheduled invocations to fail authorization. Make the target wait for the permission resource.
